name: chassis-delegation
description: brain-seat delegation for Claude Code: tiering, verification, background debrief and eval, dashboard

autoEscalate.title: Auto-escalate
autoEscalate.description: On a failing verdict, resume the worker (first failure) or respawn it one tier up (second) without asking

applyAmends.title: Apply hand-back amends
applyAmends.description: Append the hand-back's scope+= / forbid+= amend blocks to the brief before verifying (the chassis amend protocol); a block with scope-= or forbid-= always waits for approval. Off lists every block on the verdict row instead

defaultBudget.title: Default budget
defaultBudget.description: Attempts per task when the brief names no budget=<n>-attempts: 3 covers a spawn, a resume, and a respawn one tier up

gateMap.title: Gate map (JSON)
gateMap.description: Brief gate= id to the command the verifier re-runs in the worker's worktree, by argv (no shell); {files} is files.txt; chain with " && ". No sf, git, gh, network, rm or publish. Ids the map lacks are named "gate not re-run". Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

probeModels.title: Probe candidate models
probeModels.description: Once a day, ask each candidate model id one token and toast the first time one answers

candidateIds.title: Candidate model ids
candidateIds.description: Comma-separated model ids to probe when Probe candidate models is on

briefDir.title: Brief folder
briefDir.description: Where /dispatch writes <TASK-ID>.brief.md; empty = <repo root>/.delegation/briefs/ (the session scratchpad briefs/ only when the root is not writable)

briefTemplate.title: Brief template
briefTemplate.description: A template file for the brief body; empty = the repo file's briefTemplate, else the mod's hooks/templates/brief.md

agentTypes.title: Agent type per domain (JSON)
agentTypes.description: Card domain to the subagent type /dispatch spawns; built in: frontend and backend to their own, every other domain to general-purpose. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

tierMap.title: Tier map (JSON)
tierMap.description: Tier to model alias, e.g. {"standard":"opus"}; built in: economy haiku, standard sonnet, frontier opus (fable is never spawned, it becomes opus). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

spendByTier.title: Spend ceiling per tier (JSON)
spendByTier.description: Dollars one attempt may spend, per tier, e.g. {"standard":8}; built in: economy 2, standard 6, frontier 15; 0 means no ceiling. /dispatch writes it as spend= in the brief (a card's own spend: wins); the mod warns the worker once at the ceiling and records over-spend at twice it. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Comma-separated card domains /dispatch accepts (each becomes agent/<domain>/<id>); built in: frontend, backend, ops, dispatcher, cross, shared. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

briefExtra.title: Brief extra lines
briefExtra.description: Lines the brief adds under its rules, for what only this repo needs (a gate script, a test command). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

worktreeRoot.title: Worktree folder
worktreeRoot.description: Where /dispatch adds worktrees: <folder>/<repo name>-<id>; empty = beside the repo (<root>-<id>). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

verdictVerbosity.title: Verdict verbosity
verdictVerbosity.description: line: one line per verdict (the claim lines go to the debug log); full: the verdict line plus the verifier's claim lines; silent: no row, a toast only

maxWorkers.title: Max workers
maxWorkers.description: Briefed workers that run at once (built in: 2); a briefed spawn past it is queued and starts when a slot frees (ad hoc spawns never wait). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

autoDebrief.title: Background debrief
autoDebrief.description: At a clean stop (idle, no worker, nothing pending or queued, enough friction, past the cooldown) a background agent writes a debrief: ~/.claude/commands/debrief.md when it exists, else the built-in hooks/templates/debrief.md into <root>/.delegation/debriefs/

debriefIdleMinutes.title: Debrief idle minutes
debriefIdleMinutes.description: Minutes without a turn before the clean-stop check runs

debriefMinNewLines.title: Debrief new breadcrumb lines
debriefMinNewLines.description: With a harness breadcrumb file: the lines past its .done watermark a debrief needs

debriefMinEvents.title: Debrief friction events
debriefMinEvents.description: With no breadcrumb file: corrections typed (a prompt starting no/stop/don't/actually) + tool calls denied + refuted verdicts since the last debrief that a debrief needs

debriefCooldownHours.title: Debrief cooldown hours
debriefCooldownHours.description: Hours between two background debriefs of one session

debriefAgent.title: Debrief agent type
debriefAgent.description: The subagent type the background debrief runs as

autoEval.title: Background eval
autoEval.description: When origin/main has moved and the session is idle, an eval-runner subagent runs evalCommand once per sha. Runs only when an evalCommand is set (here or in the repo file); the repo file can turn it on too

evalIdleMinutes.title: Eval idle minutes
evalIdleMinutes.description: Minutes without a turn before the eval trigger looks at origin/main

evalCommand.title: Eval command (T1)
evalCommand.description: What the eval runner subagent runs (the mod itself never runs it); none built in. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

evalLive.title: Live eval (T2)
evalLive.description: After a clean T1, run the live eval once a session within the cost ceiling

evalLiveCommand.title: Eval command (T2)
evalLiveCommand.description: What the live eval runner runs; none built in. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

evalLiveMaxUsd.title: Live eval ceiling (USD)
evalLiveMaxUsd.description: What one T2 run may spend; T2 runs only while the session cost plus this stays within the session cap

sessionUsdCap.title: Session cost cap (USD)
sessionUsdCap.description: T2 never starts when the session cost plus the T2 ceiling would pass this

evalAgent.title: Eval agent type
evalAgent.description: The subagent type the eval runner runs as

ledgerFile.title: Ledger file
ledgerFile.description: Append one JSON line per judged attempt to <repo root>/.delegation/ledger.jsonl

gitGuard.title: Git guard
gitGuard.description: Deny a Bash git commit, merge, cherry-pick, rebase or push on a guarded branch (and a push naming one from any branch): branch first

guardBranches.title: Guarded branches
guardBranches.description: Comma-separated branches the git guard holds

baseRef.title: Base ref
baseRef.description: Where a brief's delta starts when it names no base=: a ref such as main or HEAD. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in chain origin/main, main, origin/master, master; a value here wins over both

ignore.title: Ignore globs (repo=here)
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs subtracted from a repo=here dirty-tree delta before the files= and scope checks, each disclosed on the ignored: line. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in .delegation/**; a value here wins over both

dashboardBand.title: Dashboard band
dashboardBand.description: Draw the delegation band above the prompt while a worker is live, queued or owed a verdict; hover it for the spend chart and worktrees, [ details ] opens the pane. Off hides the band; /delegation dashboard still opens the pane

delegateOnly.title: Delegate only (off | warn | deny)
delegateOnly.description: Keep an opus or fable brain from doing worker work itself. warn: its Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Bash writes into the repo run, and the mod posts one row per turn saying so; deny: they are refused, naming the card tool. The card folder, .delegation/, .chassis-delegation.json, CHANGELOG.md and any docs/ folder stay writable. A sonnet or haiku brain, and workers, are never restricted. Empty or off = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else off; a value here wins over it

cardDir.title: Card folder
cardDir.description: Where the task cards live, relative to the repo root (default agents/tasks). In a repo that is itself a plugin keep it out of agents/, which the engine reads as subagent definitions. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

classifierSecondOpinion.title: Classifier second opinion
classifierSecondOpinion.description: In the card tool's dry run, ask the tier classifier once and print its tier beside the card's (card says standard · classifier says economy); never on a dispatch. Off skips the call
